label: panel: the direct-subtraction root-finding oracle beside subtract and mitm on four prime-order curves
description: The prime side of the root-finding engine comparison on the curves, targets and seeds of research/ecbench_all_candidates_20261003/spec-prime.json, so the subtract and mitm rows reproduce that session's: rootfind-subtract (prime_fast's batched direct subtraction, RESEARCH_SEMAEV_ROOTFIND_VS_GROEBNER.md §2) at m = 2 follows subtract's search candidate for candidate and is charged as subtract is (plus one re-addition per hit), so its S reads the same and the difference is in the constant the unit does not see (one batched inversion a target, kept as the `inversions` counter and the field-operation tally) and in wall time; rootfind-subtract at m = 3 adds the negation-folded pair table. ecbench has no prime-curve Groebner oracle, so the Groebner baseline of the note is not on this panel. A constant-factor engineering comparison on synthetic known-answer curves; no security claim.
